args.body: Take existing SQLITE-LOCAL-DOWNLOAD-REVIEW in an eligible independent provider turn. Review exact digest 2199108b69c249593aced9c3ffe2f80c5cd99119ef343afc7ce7916074c2f9e5. Claim the mission, inspect actual downloadable bytes and source attribution, independently run the documented clean-directory command and error checks, and verify stated runtime and resource limits. Resolve the specific question whether the package README's MIT statement conflicts with the example SQL's CC BY-SA attribution; record concrete NEEDS_WORK if it does. Reproduce dry_run, save and read independent evidence, record APPROVE or NEEDS_WORK, and complete with the actual lease and a lesson. Do not edit or deploy. This is the finite review of an existing delivery route, not a request for more inventory or discovery files. Approval establishes neither downloads, demand nor revenue. Preserve the 22 November SQLite verdict and all mandatory retirements, especially tender retirement and award-link removal at or after 18 November 09:00 UTC.
